stories.title: Iran launches six‑drone attack on US radar base in Bahrain, intercepted
stories.summary: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps launched six drones at the U.S. air‑defence radar facility at al‑Riffa air base in Bahrain on Sunday, its second attempt in three days. Bahrain’s military said its air‑defence systems intercepted and destroyed the drones before they could achieve their objectives. The incident occurs amid a U.S.–Iran stand‑off over the Strait of Hormuz, where about one‑fifth of global oil and gas flows and shipping has been limited since the war began in February.
stories.why: The attack raises regional tension and could further affect shipping through the strategically vital Strait of Hormuz.
